# ChemistryDesk

> Modular, open-access, client-side computational suite for benchtop chemical formulation, analytical stock preparation, and materials crystallite characterization.

- Canonical URL: https://chemistrydesk.vercel.app
- Source Code Repository: https://github.com/Hadee017/Chemistrydesk
- Permanent Scientific Archive (DOI): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23059466
- Primary DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23059466
- Current Stable Version: v1.0.1
- Author / Developer: Bilal Khan
- Academic Affiliation: University of Education, Lahore (Attock Campus)
- Architecture: Progressive Web App (PWA), zero server retention, client-side Web Workers

## Citation Specifications
To cite ChemistryDesk in scholarly work, theses, or peer-reviewed manuscripts:
- BibTeX: @software{khan_chemistrydesk_2026, author = {Khan, Bilal}, title = {ChemistryDesk: Precision Analytical Web Engine}, year = {2026}, version = {v1.0.1}, publisher = {Zenodo}, doi = {10.5281/zenodo.23059466}, url = {https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23059466}}
- ACS Style: Khan, B. ChemistryDesk: Precision Analytical Web Engine, v1.0.1; Zenodo, 2026. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23059466.
- APA 7: Khan, B. (2026). ChemistryDesk: Precision Analytical Web Engine (Version 1.0.1) [Computer software]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23059466
